findings.text: D2 requires screening inside a timed task, but `visitCandidates` now calls `screen candidate value` outside `awaitCompiled`, and the generator skips screening its last allowed candidate, so that candidate can block without timeout or cancellation. Fix: evaluate the final screen inside `awaitCompiled` and return its result.

The stated share limit contradicts `max 1` in `visitCandidates`, which allocates another generated candidate even when the empty or named database has consumed the remaining budget. Fix: permit a zero share and stop generation when the total budget is exhausted.
The per-value allocation policy is embedded in the traversal instead of a named definition with a docstring. Fix: extract a documented quota definition and use it here.

No regression test distinguishes the new stopping predicate or per-value allocation from the previous behavior. Fix: add deterministic tests for early stopping, continuation after rejection, and reaching a later parameter value within the total candidate budget.
